rationale: FOXF has gapped down ~19% with no news context available, making the catalyst unknown and the directional edge unclear. The stock is recovering intraday (74% of range, above VWAP and 9-EMA), but the spread is wide at 63 bps, and without knowing the reason for the gap, both continuation lower and further recovery are equally plausible. With today already showing a realized loss and limited daily loss budget remaining, the risk/reward does not justify entry into a high-volatility, news-unknown situation.
